75 76 77 ## 🔥 Update 78 80 81 82 * [2026-01-28]: 🚀 [CamReasoner-7B](https://huggingface.co/LaurentWu/CamReasoner-7B) released on Huggingface. 83 * [2026-01-28]: 🚀 Codes and training dataset released. 84 85 ## 🎯 Overview 86
87 88
89 90 Abstract: Understanding camera dynamics is a fundamental pillar of video spatial intelligence. However, existing multimodal models predominantly treat this task as a black-box classification, often confusing physically distinct motions by relying on superficial visual patterns rather than geometric cues. We present **CamReasoner**, a framework that reformulates camera movement understanding as a structured inference process to bridge the gap between perception and cinematic logic. Our approach centers on the Observation-Thinking-Answer (O-T-A) paradigm, which compels the model to decode spatio-temporal cues such as trajectories and view frustums within an explicit reasoning block. To instill this capability, we construct a Large-scale Inference Trajectory Suite comprising 18k SFT reasoning chains and 38k RL feedback samples. Notably, we are the **first to employ RL for logical alignment in this domain**, ensuring motion inferences are grounded in physical geometry rather than contextual guesswork. By applying Reinforcement Learning to the Observation-Think-Answer (O-T-A) reasoning paradigm, CamReasoner effectively suppresses hallucinations and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks. 91 92 93 ## 🕹️ Usage 94 95 ### Supervised Fine-tuning 96 97 Supervised Fine-Tuning establishes a foundational reasoning baseline by injecting structured templates and domain-specific knowledge, enabling the model to follow instructions and generate coherent initial responses. 98 99 ```bash 100 git clone https://github.com/wuhang03/CamReasoner 101 cd CamReasoner 102 103 # build SFT environment 104 conda create -n sft python=3.11 105 conda activate sft 106 cd LLaMA-Factory 107 bash setup.sh 108 109 # download data 110 bash download.sh 111 112 # run sft (modify parameters according to your need) 113 bash local_scripts/run_sft.sh 114 ``` 115 116 Our proposed SFT dataset **CamReasoning-SFT-18k** is in [camerabench_sft.json](LLaMA-Factory/data/camerabench_sft.json). If you want to train models on your own curated data, you can convert their format as shown in our json file. 117 118 ### Reinforcement Learning 119 120 Reinforcement Learning drives the model to self-evolve through trial and error, refining the internal logic chain and optimizing decision-making performance beyond the limitations of static training data. 121 122 ```bash 123 git clone https://github.com/wuhang03/CamReasoner 124 cd CamReasoner 125 126 # build RL environment 127 conda create -n rl python=3.11 128 conda activate rl 129 cd EasyR1 130 bash setup.sh 131 132 # download data 133 bash download.sh 134 135 # run rl (modify parameters according to your need) 136 bash local_scripts/run_rl.sh 137 ``` 138 139 Our proposed RL dataset **CamReasoning-RL-38k** is in [camerabench_rl.json](EasyR1/camerabench_rl.json). If you want to train models on your own curated data, you can convert their format as shown in our json file. 140 141 142 For more details for the SFT and RL environment installation, please refer to [LLaMA-Factory](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory), [EasyR1](https://github.com/hiyouga/EasyR1) 143 144 ### Inference 145 146 You can use CamReasoner-7B to inference and see the reasoning process following this part. We provide the results in [CamReasoner_binary.json](Inference/results/CamReasoner_binary.json) and [CamReasoner_vqa.json](Inference/results/CamReasoner_vqa.json) to help visualizing the observe-think-answer reasoning paradigm. 147 148 ```bash 149 git clone https://github.com/wuhang03/CamReasoner 150 cd CamReasoner 151 152 # build inference environment 153 conda create -n infer python=3.11 154 conda activate infer 155 cd Inference 156 bash setup.sh 157 158 # download data 159 python data_download.py 160 161 # run inference (modify parameters according to your need) 162 bash infer/infer.sh 163 ``` 164 165 The evaluation data are from [CameraBench](https://github.com/sy77777en/CameraBench), including questions and videos. You can refer to [CameraBench](https://github.com/sy77777en/CameraBench) for more details. 166 167 You can also refer to [ShotBench](https://github.com/Vchitect/ShotBench) and [RefineShot](https://github.com/wuhang03/RefineShot) for out-of-domain camera movement understanding evaluation and reasoning reliability evaluation. These evaluation can be run simply modifying `MODEL_NAME` and `CATEGORY` in evaluate_qwen.sh in [RefineShot](https://github.com/wuhang03/RefineShot). 168 169 ## 📈 Training Curves 170 171

118	
119	        Args:

122

125	            4 channels = forward_flow_x, forward_flow_y, backward_flow_x, backward_flow_y.
126	        """
127	        target_h, target_w = 320, 480  # fixed resolution for motion encoder
128	        out_dtype = video_frames[0].dtype  # remember caller dtype (bf16) for output cast
129	        results = []

132	        # (VideoFlow internals create float32 coords/grids that conflict with bf16 weights).

138	                T, C, H, W = video.shape

140	
141	                # Resize to fixed resolution if not already pre-resized by data processor
142	                if H != target_h or W != target_w:

145	                hidden = self._extract_motion_hidden(video.unsqueeze(0))  # [T-2, hdim, H/dr, W/dr]
146	
147	                # Pad boundary frames by replicating the nearest hidden state
148	                hidden = torch.cat([hidden[:1], hidden, hidden[-1:]], dim=0)  # [T, hdim, H/dr, W/dr]
149	                results.append(hidden.to(out_dtype))

151	        return results

153	    def _extract_motion_hidden(self, images):
154	        """
155	        Run MOFNet components step by step and return the hidden state
156	        after the final iterative refinement.
157	
158	        Args:
159	            images: [1, N, 3, H, W] tensor, float in [0, 255].
160	
161	        Returns:
162	            [N-2, hidden_dim, H/dr, W/dr] tensor containing motion features.
163	        """
164	        mofnet = self.mofnet
165	        B, N, _, H, W = images.shape
166	        dr = self._down_ratio
167	        hdim = self._hidden_dim
168	
169	        # Normalize to [-1, 1]
170	        images_norm = 2.0 * (images / 255.0) - 1.0
171	
172	        # 1. Feature extraction (per-frame)
173	        fmaps = mofnet.fnet(images_norm.reshape(B * N, 3, H, W))
174	        fmaps = fmaps.reshape(B, N, -1, H // dr, W // dr)
175	
176	        # 2. Build correlation volumes between adjacent frames
177	        middle = fmaps[:, 1:N-1].reshape(B * (N - 2), -1, H // dr, W // dr)
178	        forward_ref = fmaps[:, 2:N].reshape(B * (N - 2), -1, H // dr, W // dr)
179	        backward_ref = fmaps[:, 0:N-2].reshape(B * (N - 2), -1, H // dr, W // dr)
180	
181	        forward_corr_fn = CorrBlock(
182	            middle, forward_ref,
183	            num_levels=mofnet.cfg.corr_levels,
184	            radius=mofnet.cfg.corr_radius,
185	        )
186	        backward_corr_fn = CorrBlock(
187	            middle, backward_ref,
188	            num_levels=mofnet.cfg.corr_levels,
189	            radius=mofnet.cfg.corr_radius,
190	        )
191	
192	        # 3. Context encoder (for middle frames)
193	        cnet = mofnet.cnet(images_norm[:, 1:N-1].reshape(B * (N - 2), 3, H, W))
194	        if mofnet.cfg.context_3D:
195	            cnet = cnet.reshape(B, N - 2, -1, H // dr, W // dr).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
196	            cnet = mofnet.context_3D(cnet) + cnet
197	            cnet = cnet.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * (N - 2), -1, H // dr, W // dr)
198	
199	        net, inp = torch.split(cnet, [hdim, hdim], dim=1)
200	        net = torch.tanh(net)
201	        inp = torch.relu(inp)
202	        attention = mofnet.att(inp)
203	
204	        # 4. Initialize flow coordinates
205	        bs = B * (N - 2)
206	        coords0 = coords_grid(bs, H // dr, W // dr).to(images.device)
207	        forward_coords0 = coords0.clone()
208	        forward_coords1 = coords0.clone()
209	        backward_coords0 = coords0.clone()
210	        backward_coords1 = coords0.clone()
211	
212	        # 5. Iterative refinement (the core motion estimation loop)
213	        motion_hidden_state = None
214	        for _ in range(self._decoder_depth):
215	            forward_coords1 = forward_coords1.detach()
216	            backward_coords1 = backward_coords1.detach()
217	
218	            forward_corr = forward_corr_fn(forward_coords1)
219	            backward_corr = backward_corr_fn(backward_coords1)
220	
221	            forward_flow = forward_coords1 - forward_coords0
222	            backward_flow = backward_coords1 - backward_coords0
223	
224	            net, motion_hidden_state, up_mask, delta_flow = mofnet.update_block(
225	                net, motion_hidden_state, inp,
226	                forward_corr, backward_corr,
227	                forward_flow, backward_flow,
228	                forward_coords0, attention, bs=B,
229	            )
230	
231	            forward_coords1 = forward_coords1 + delta_flow[:, 0:2]
232	            backward_coords1 = backward_coords1 + delta_flow[:, 2:4]
233	
234	        # 6. Extract final optical flow (forward + backward, 4 channels)
235	        final_forward_flow = forward_coords1 - forward_coords0   # [B*(N-2), 2, H/dr, W/dr]
236	        final_backward_flow = backward_coords1 - backward_coords0  # [B*(N-2), 2, H/dr,

101	        spatial_patch_size = 14  # Qwen2.5-VL spatial patch size

105	        std = torch.tensor(CLIP_STD, dtype=torch.float32)

108	        grid_idx = 0

112	            forward_flow = flow[:, :2]  # [T, 2, H, W]
113	            T, _, H, W = forward_flow.shape
114	            device = forward_flow.device
115	
116	            # Construct 3 channels: (magnitude, dx, dy)
117	            dx = forward_flow[:, 0:1]  # [T, 1, H, W]
118	            dy = forward_flow[:, 1:2]  # [T, 1, H, W]
119	            magnitude = torch.sqrt(dx ** 2 + dy ** 2 + 1e-8)  # [T, 1, H, W]
120	            pseudo_img = torch.cat([magnitude, dx, dy], dim=1)  # [T, 3, H, W]

124	            vmax = pseudo_img.max()

127	            else:

129	
130	            # Apply CLIP normalization
131	            mean_dev = mean.to(device).view(1, 3, 1, 1)
132	            std_dev = std.to(device).view(1, 3, 1, 1)
133	            pseudo_img = (pseudo_img - mean_dev) / std_dev
134	
135	            # Get target resolution from grid_thw
136	            gt, gh, gw = video_grid_thw[grid_idx].tolist()
137	            gt, gh, gw = int(gt), int(gh), int(gw)
138	            grid_idx += 1
139	
140	            target_H = gh * spatial_patch_size  # grid_h * 14
141	            target_W = gw * spatial_patch_size  # grid_w * 14
142	            target_T = gt * temporal_patch_size  # grid_t * 2
143	
144	            # Resize spatial dimensions
145	            pseudo_img = F.interpolate(
146	                pseudo_img.float(), size=(target_H, target_W),
147	                mode='bilinear', align_corners=False,
148	            )  # [T, 3, target_H, target_W]
149	
150	            # Temporal alignment to target_T
151	            if T < target_T:
152	                pad = pseudo_img[-1:].expand(target_T - T, -1, -1, -1)
153	                pseudo_img = torch.cat([pseudo_img, pad], dim=0)
154	            elif T > target_T:
155	                indices = torch.linspace(0, T - 1, target_T, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
156	                pseudo_img = pseudo_img[indices]
157	            # pseudo_img: [target_T, 3, target_H, target_W]
158	
159	            # Patchify: match Qwen2.5-VL processor's merge-grouped order.
160	            # The ViT groups every spatial_merge_size^2 (=4) consecutive patches
161	            # into a merge block, so the order must be:
162	            # [gt, gh//merge, gw//merge, merge_h, merge_w, C, t_patch, H_patch, W_patch]
163	            spatial_merge_size = 2
164	            pseudo_img = pseudo_img.view(
165	                gt, temporal_patch_size,                                           # 0, 1
166	                3,                                                                 # 2
167	                gh // spatial_merge_size, spatial_merge_size, spatial_patch_size,   # 3, 4, 5
168	                gw // spatial_merge_size, spatial_merge_size, spatial_patch_size,   # 6, 7, 8
169	            )
170	            pseudo_img = pseudo_img.permute(0, 3, 6, 4, 7, 2, 1, 5, 8).contiguous()
171	            # [gt, gh//2, gw//2, merge_h, merge_w, 3, 2, 14, 14]
172	            n_patches = gt * gh * gw
173	            pseudo_img = pseudo_img.view(n_patches, 3 * temporal_patch_size * spatial_patch_size * spatial_patch_size)
174	            # [n_patches, 1176]
175	
176	            all_patches.append(pseudo_img)
177	
178	        pixel_values_flow = torch.cat(all_patches, dim=0)
179	        flow_grid_thw = video_grid_thw.clone()
180	
181	        return pixel_values_flow, flow_grid_thw

35	    def __init__(self, config):

37	        self.motion_encoder = VideoFlowMotionEncoderPreTrainedModel(config.motion_config)
38	        self.connector = get_connector(config)

41	    def _flow_to_visual_input(
42	        self,
43	        flow_list: List[torch.Tensor],
44	        video_grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
45	    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
46	        """Convert optical flow into Qwen3-VL pseudo-image patches.
47	
48	        Qwen3-VL uses patch_size=16, temporal_patch_size=2, spatial_merge_size=2.
49	        The patchified width is 3 * 2 * 16 * 16 = 1536.
50	        """
51	        temporal_patch_size = int(self.config.vision_config.temporal_patch_size)
52	        spatial_patch_size = int(self.config.vision_config.patch_size)
53	        spatial_merge_size = int(self.config.vision_config.spatial_merge_size)
54	
55	        mean = torch.tensor(CLIP_MEAN, dtype=torch.float32)
56	        std = torch.tensor(CLIP_STD, dtype=torch.float32)
57	        all_patches = []
58	        grid_idx = 0
59	
60	        for flow in flow_list:
61	            forward_flow = flow[:, :2]
62	            dx = forward_flow[:, 0:1]
63	            dy = forward_flow[:, 1:2]
64	            magnitude = torch.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2 + 1e-8)
65	            pseudo_img = torch.cat([magnitude, dx, dy], dim=1)
66	
67	            vmin = pseudo_img.min()
68	            vmax = pseudo_img.max()
69	            if vmax - vmin > 1e-6:
70	                pseudo_img = (pseudo_img - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
71	            else:
72	                pseudo_img = torch.zeros_like(pseudo_img)
73	
74	            device = pseudo_img.device
75	            pseudo_img = (pseudo_img - mean.to(device).view(1, 3, 1, 1)) / std.to(device).view(1, 3, 1, 1)
76	
77	            gt, gh, gw = [int(v) for v in video_grid_thw[grid_idx].tolist()]
78	            grid_idx += 1
79	            target_h = gh * spatial_patch_size
80	            target_w = gw * spatial_patch_size
81	            target_t = gt * temporal_patch_size
82	
83	            pseudo_img = F.interpolate(
84	                pseudo_img.float(),
85	                size=(target_h, target_w),
86	                mode="bilinear",
87	                align_corners=False,
88	            )
89	
90	            cur_t = pseudo_img.shape[0]
91	            if cur_t < target_t:
92	                pad = pseudo_img[-1:].expand(target_t - cur_t, -1, -1, -1)
93	                pseudo_img = torch.cat([pseudo_img, pad], dim=0)
94	            elif cur_t > target_t:
95	                indices = torch.linspace(0, cur_t - 1, target_t, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
96	                pseudo_img = pseudo_img[indices]
97	
98	            pseudo_img = pseudo_img.view(
99	                gt,
100	                temporal_patch_size,
101	                3,
102	                gh // spatial_merge_size,
103	                spatial_merge_size,
104	                spatial_patch_size,
105	                gw // spatial_merge_size,
106	                spatial_merge_size,
107	                spatial_patch_size,
108	            )
109	            pseudo_img = pseudo_img.permute(0, 3, 6, 4, 7, 2, 1, 5, 8).contiguous()
110	            pseudo_img = pseudo_img.view(
111	                gt * gh * gw,
112	                3 * temporal_patch_size * spatial_patch_size * spatial_patch_size,
113	            )
114	            all_patches.append(pseudo_img)
115	
116	        return torch.cat(all_patches, dim=0), video_grid_thw.clone()

1	import torch
2	import torch.nn as nn
3	import torch.nn.functional as F
4	
5	
6	class VisualFlowAttentionConnector(nn.Module):
7	    """Token-aligned cross-attention fusion in Qwen hidden space.
8	
9	    Visual tokens attend to flow tokens on a per-video basis:
10	        flow_h = MLP(LN(flow))
11	        fused = visual + CrossAttn(LN(visual), LN(flow_h), LN(flow_h))
12	    """
13	
14	    def __init__(self, lang_dim: int, num_heads: int = 8, **kwargs):
15	        super().__init__()
16	        self.lang_dim = lang_dim
17	        self.attn_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.01))
18	        self.ln_flow = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
19	        self.flow_mlp = nn.Sequential(
20	            nn.Linear(lang_dim, 2048),
21	            nn.GELU(),
22	            nn.Linear(2048, lang_dim),
23	        )
24	        self.ln_q = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
25	        self.ln_kv = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
26	        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(lang_dim, num_heads=num_heads, batch_first=True)
27	
28	    def _split_sizes(self, grid_thw: torch.Tensor, total_tokens: int):
29	        if grid_thw is None:
30	            return [total_tokens]
31	
32	        split_sizes = [int(t) * int(h) * int(w) for t, h, w in grid_thw.tolist()]
33	        if sum(split_sizes) != total_tokens:
34	            raise ValueError(
35	                f"grid_thw token count mismatch: expected {sum(split_sizes)}, got {total_tokens}"
36	            )
37	        return split_sizes
38	
39	    def _cross_attn_f32(self, query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
40	        """Run attention in float32 to keep bf16 training numerically stable."""
41	        ca = self.cross_attn
42	        embed_dim = ca.embed_dim
43	        num_heads = ca.num_heads
44	        head_dim = embed_dim // num_heads
45	        batch_size, q_len, _ = query.shape
46	        _, kv_len, _ = key.shape
47	
48	        q = F.linear(query.float(), ca.in_proj_weight[:embed_dim].float(), ca.in_proj_bias[:embed_dim].float())
49	        k = F.linear(
50	            key.float(),
51	            ca.in_proj_weight[embed_dim : 2 * embed_dim].float(),
52	            ca.in_proj_bias[embed_dim : 2 * embed_dim].float(),
53	        )
54	        v = F.linear(
55	            value.float(),
56	            ca.in_proj_weight[2 * embed_dim :].float(),
57	            ca.in_proj_bias[2 * embed_dim :].float(),
58	        )
59	
60	        q = q.view(batch_size, q_len, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
61	        k = k.view(batch_size, kv_len, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
62	        v = v.view(batch_size, kv_len, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
63	
64	        out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
65	        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size, q_len, embed_dim)
66	        out = F.linear(out, ca.out_proj.weight.float(), ca.out_proj.bias.float())
67	        return out
68	
69	    def _flow_mlp_f32(self, flow_embeds: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
70	        """Project flow tokens in float32 while keeping the hidden size unchanged."""
71	        flow_hidden = F.layer_norm(
72	            flow_embeds.float(),
73	            self.ln_flow.normalized_shape,
74	            self.ln_flow.weight.float(),
75	            self.ln_flow.bias.float(),
76	            self.ln_flow.eps,
77	        )
78	        flow_hidden = F.linear(
79	            flow_hidden,
80	            self.flow_mlp[0].weight.float(),
81	            self.flow_mlp[0].bias.float(),
82	        )
83	        flow_hidden = F.gelu(flow_hidden)
84	        flow_hidden = F.linear(
85	            flow_hidden,
86	            self.flow_mlp[2].weight.float(),
87	            self.flow_mlp[2].bias.float(),
88	        )
89	        return flow_hidden
90	
91	    def forward(
92	        self,
93	        visual_embeds: torch.Tensor,
94	        flow_embeds: torch.Tensor,
95	        grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
96	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
97	        orig_dtype = visual_embeds.dtype
98	        split_sizes = self._split_sizes(grid_thw, visual_embeds.shape[0])
99	        visual_chunks = torch.split(visual_embeds, split_sizes, dim=0)
100	        flow_chunks = torch.split(flow_embeds, split_sizes, dim=0)
101	
102	        fused_chunks = []
103	        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=False):
104	            for visual_chunk, flow_chunk in zip(visual_chunks, flow_chunks):
105	                visual_f32 = visual_chunk.float()
106	                flow_hidden = self._flow_mlp_f32(flow_chunk)
107	
108	                query = F.layer_norm(
109	                    visual_f32,
110	                    self.ln_q.normalized_shape,
111	                    self.ln_q.weight.float(),
112	                    self.ln_q.bias.float(),
113	                    self.ln_q.eps,
114	                ).unsqueeze(0)
115	                key_value = F.layer_norm(
116	                    flow_hidden,
117	                    self.ln_kv.normalized_shape,
118	                    self.ln_kv.weight.float(),
119	                    self.ln_kv.bias.float(),
120	                    self.ln_kv.eps,
121	                ).unsqueeze(0)
122	
123	                attn_out = self._cross_attn_f32(query, key_value, key_value).squeeze(0)
124	                fused_chunks.append(visual_f32 + self.attn_scale.float() * attn_out)
125	
126	        return torch.cat(fused_chunks, dim=0).to(orig_dtype)
127	
128	    def print_trainable_parameters(self) -> None:
129	        trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
130	        total = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
131	        is_trainable = any(p.requires_grad for p in self.parameters())
132	        print(
133	            f"VisualFlowAttentionConnector Trainable: {is_trainable} "
134	            f"({trainable:,}/{total:,} params)"
135	        )

23	        )
24	        self.ln_q = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
25	        self.ln_kv = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
26	        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(lang_dim, num_heads=num_heads, batch_first=True)
27	
28	    def _split_sizes(self, grid_thw: torch.Tensor, total_tokens: int):
29	        if grid_thw is None:
30	            return [total_tokens]
31	
32	        split_sizes = [int(t) * int(h) * int(w) for t, h, w in grid_thw.tolist()]
33	        if sum(split_sizes) != total_tokens:
34	            raise ValueError(
35	                f"grid_thw token count mismatch: expected {sum(split_sizes)}, got {total_tokens}"
36	            )
37	        return split_sizes
38	
39	    def _cross_attn_f32(self, query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
40	        """Run attention in float32 to keep bf16 training numerically stable."""
41	        ca = self.cross_attn
42	        embed_dim = ca.embed_dim
43	        num_heads = ca.num_heads
44	        head_dim = embed_dim // num_heads
45	        batch_size, q_len, _ = query.shape
46	        _, kv_len, _ = key.shape
47	
48	        q = F.linear(query.float(), ca.in_proj_weight[:embed_dim].float(), ca.in_proj_bias[:embed_dim].float())
49	        k = F.linear(
50	            key.float(),
51	            ca.in_proj_weight[embed_dim : 2 * embed_dim].float(),
52	            ca.in_proj_bias[embed_dim : 2 * embed_dim].float(),
53	        )
54	        v = F.linear(
55	            value.float(),
56	            ca.in_proj_weight[2 * embed_dim :].float(),
57	            ca.in_proj_bias[2 * embed_dim :].float(),
58	        )
59	
60	        q = q.view(batch_size, q_len, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
61	        k = k.view(batch_size, kv_len, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
62	        v = v.view(batch_size, kv_len, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
63	
64	        out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
65	        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size, q_len, embed_dim)
66	        out = F.linear(out, ca.out_proj.weight.float(), ca.out_proj.bias.float())
67	        return out
68	
69	    def _flow_mlp_f32(self, flow_embeds: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
70	        """Project flow tokens in float32 while keeping the hidden size unchanged."""
71	        flow_hidden = F.layer_norm(
72	            flow_embeds.float(),
73	            self.ln_flow.normalized_shape,
74	            self.ln_flow.weight.float(),
75	            self.ln_flow.bias.float(),
76	            self.ln_flow.eps,
77	        )
78	        flow_hidden = F.linear(
79	            flow_hidden,
80	            self.flow_mlp[0].weight.float(),
81	            self.flow_mlp[0].bias.float(),
82	        )
83	        flow_hidden = F.gelu(flow_hidden)
84	        flow_hidden = F.linear(
85	            flow_hidden,
86	            self.flow_mlp[2].weight.float(),
87	            self.flow_mlp[2].bias.float(),
88	        )
89	        return flow_hidden
90	
91	    def forward(
92	        self,
93	        visual_embeds: torch.Tensor,
94	        flow_embeds: torch.Tensor,
95	        grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
96	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
97	        orig_dtype = visual_embeds.dtype
98	        split_sizes = self._split_sizes(grid_thw, visual_embeds.shape[0])
99	        visual_chunks = torch.split(visual_embeds, split_sizes, dim=0)
100	        flow_chunks = torch.split(flow_embeds, split_sizes, dim=0)
101	
102	        fused_chunks = []
103	        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=False):
104	            for visual_chunk, flow_chunk in zip(visual_chunks, flow_chunks):
105	                visual_f32 = visual_chunk.float()
106	                flow_hidden = self._flow_mlp_f32(flow_chunk)
107	
108	                query = F.layer_norm(
109	                    visual_f32,
110	                    self.ln_q.normalized_shape,
111	                    self.ln_q.weight.float(),
112	                    self.ln_q.bias.float(),
113	                    self.ln_q.eps,
114	                ).unsqueeze(0)
115	                key_value = F.layer_norm(
116	                    flow_hidden,
117	                    self.ln_kv.normalized_shape,
118	                    self.ln_kv.weight.float(),
119	                    self.ln_kv.bias.float(),
120	                    self.ln_kv.eps,
121	                ).unsqueeze(0)
122	
123	                attn_out = self._cross_attn_f32(query, key_value, key_value).squeeze(0)
124	                fused_chunks.append(visual_f32 + self.attn_scale.float() * attn_out)
125	
126	        return torch.cat(fused_chunks, dim=0).to(orig_dtype)
127	
128	    def print_trainable_parameters(self) -> None:
129	        trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
130	        total = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
131	        is_trainable = any(p.requires_grad for p in self.parameters())
132	        print(
133	            f"VisualFlowAttentionConnector Trainable: {is_trainable} "
134	            f"({trainable:,}/{total:,} params)"
135	        )

3	
4	Pipeline:
5	    MOFNet → flow → 3ch pseudo-image → Qwen ViT (frozen) → flow_embeds [N, lang_dim]
6	    → LayerNorm → MLP → direct add with visual_embeds
7

14	import torch.nn as nn

17	class VisualFlowConnector(nn.Module):

19	
20	    Architecture (following Spatial-MLLM's MLPAddConnector):
21	        1. LayerNorm on flow_embeds
22	        2. MLP: Linear → GELU → Linear (lang_dim → lang_dim)
23	        3. Additive fusion: visual_embeds + projected_flow
24	    """
25	
26	    def __init__(self, lang_dim: int, **kwargs):
27	        super().__init__()
28	        self.lang_dim = lang_dim
29	        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
30	        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
31	            nn.Linear(lang_dim, 2048),
32	            nn.GELU(),
33	            nn.Linear(2048, lang_dim),
34	        )

37	        self,
38	        visual_embeds: torch.Tensor,
39	        flow_embeds: torch.Tensor,
40	        grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
41	    ) -> torch.Tensor:

43	        Args:

65	class ConnectorMonitorCallback(TrainerCallback):
66	    """Log connector metrics to SwanLab; save connector weights at each checkpoint.
67	
68	    Metrics logged:
69	      - connector/mlp_weight_norm: MLP total weight norm
70	      - connector/mlp_grad_norm: MLP total gradient norm (captured via backward hook)
71	      - connector/cross_attn_weight_norm: Cross-attention total weight norm
72	      - connector/cross_attn_grad_norm: Cross-attention total gradient norm
73	    """
74	
75	    def __init__(self):
76	        super().__init__()
77	        self._last_mlp_grad_norm = 0.0
78	        self._last_cross_attn_grad_norm = 0.0
79	        self._hooks = []
80	
81	    def on_train_begin(self, args, state, control, model=None, **kwargs):
82	        """Register backward hooks to capture metrics."""
83	        if model is None:
84	            return
85	        base = _unwrap_model(model)
86	        if not hasattr(base, "connector"):
87	            print("[ConnectorMonitor] WARNING: no connector found on unwrapped model!")
88	            return
89	
90	        connector = base.connector
91	
92	        # Verify connector params are finite after all wrapping (PEFT + DeepSpeed)
93	        for name, p in connector.named_parameters():
94	            if not torch.isfinite(p.data).all():
95	                print(f"[ConnectorMonitor] WARNING: {name} contains NaN/Inf! shape={p.shape}, dtype={p.dtype}")
96	            else:
97	                print(f"[ConnectorMonitor] OK: {name} finite, norm={p.data.float().norm().item():.6f}")
98	
99	        # --- Gradient sanitization hooks (MUST be registered FIRST) ---
100	        # With DeepSpeed bf16, gradient overflow (>65504) in ANY parameter can
101	        # produce NaN that contaminates ALL gradients via gradient clipping
102	        # (scale = 1/grad_norm, if grad_norm includes NaN → scale=NaN → all grads NaN).
103	        # This hook replaces NaN/Inf gradients with 0 before they reach the optimizer.
104	        for name, p in connector.named_parameters():
105	            if p.requires_grad:
106	                def _sanitize_grad(grad, param_name=name):
107	                    if not torch.isfinite(grad).all():
108	                        n_bad = (~torch.isfinite(grad)).sum().item()
109	                        print(f"[GRAD SANITIZE] {param_name}: {n_bad}/{grad.numel()} NaN/Inf values")
110	                        return torch.nan_to_num(grad, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
111	                self._hooks.append(p.register_hook(_sanitize_grad))
112	
113	        # --- Monitoring hooks (after sanitization) ---
114	        # MLP gradient hook (check flow_mlp for VisualFlowConnector, or mlp for legacy)
115	        mlp_module = getattr(connector, "flow_mlp", None) or getattr(connector, "mlp", None)
116	        if mlp_module is not None:
117	            mlp_params = [p for p in mlp_module.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
118	            if mlp_params:
119	                def _mlp_hook(grad, self_ref=self, params=mlp_params):
120	                    total_sq = 0.0
121	                    for p in params:
122	                        if p.grad is not None:
123	                            total_sq += p.grad.data.float().norm().item() ** 2
124	                    total_sq += grad.float().norm().item() ** 2
125	                    self_ref._last_mlp_grad_norm = total_sq ** 0.5
126	                self._hooks.append(mlp_params[-1].register_hook(_mlp_hook))
127	
128	        # Cross-attention gradient hook
129	        if hasattr(connector, "cross_attn"):
130	            ca_params = [p for p in connector.cross_attn.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
131	            if ca_params:
132	                def _ca_hook(grad, self_ref=self, params=ca_params):
133	                    total_sq = 0.0
134	                    for p in params:
135	                        if p.grad is not None:
136	                            total_sq += p.grad.data.float().norm().item() ** 2
137	                    total_sq += grad.float().norm().item() ** 2
138	                    self_ref._last_cross_attn_grad_norm = total_sq ** 0.5
139	                self._hooks.append(ca_params[-1].register_hook(_ca_hook))

142	        if model is None or logs is None:

144	        base = _unwrap_model(model)
145	        if not hasattr(base, "connector"):

157

115	        mlp_module = getattr(connector, "flow_mlp", None) or getattr(connector, "mlp", None)

131	            if ca_params:

134	                    for p in params:
135	                        if p.grad is not None:
136	                            total_sq += p.grad.data.float().norm().item() ** 2
137	                    total_sq += grad.float().norm().item() ** 2

1	"""
2	FlowEncoder: Trainable optical flow encoder with temporal self-attention.
3	
4	Takes pre-computed optical flow from MOFNet (frozen) and encodes it into
5	rich spatio-temporal features for MLLM fusion.
6	
7	Pipeline:
8	    MOFNet (frozen) → optical flow [T, 4, H/8, W/8]
9	    → Conv_in → [ResBlock + TemporalSelfAttention] × N → features [T, 512, H/8, W/8]
10	
11	Reference: OnlyFlow (FlowEncoder with ResNet + Temporal Attention),
12	simplified to single-scale for MLLM token fusion.
13	"""
14	
15	import math
16	from typing import List
17	
18	import torch
19	import torch.nn as nn
20	import torch.nn.functional as F
21	from transformers import PretrainedConfig, PreTrainedModel
22	
23	
24	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25	# Config
26	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
27	
28	class FlowEncoderConfig(PretrainedConfig):
29	    model_type = "flow_encoder"
30	    base_config_key = "motion_config"
31	
32	    def __init__(
33	        self,
34	        motion_dim: int = 512,
35	        in_channels: int = 4,
36	        num_blocks: int = 4,
37	        num_heads: int = 8,
38	        max_frames: int = 128,
39	        **kwargs,
40	    ):
41	        super().__init__(**kwargs)
42	        self.motion_dim = motion_dim
43	        self.in_channels = in_channels  # 4 = forward(2) + backward(2) flow
44	        self.num_blocks = num_blocks
45	        self.num_heads = num_heads
46	        self.max_frames = max_frames
47	
48	
49	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
50	# Building blocks
51	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52	
53	class ResBlock(nn.Module):
54	    """Pre-norm residual convolution block."""
55	
56	    def __init__(self, channels: int):
57	        super().__init__()
58	        self.norm1 = nn.GroupNorm(32, channels)
59	        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, 1, 1)
60	        self.norm2 = nn.GroupNorm(32, channels)
61	        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(channels, channels, 3, 1, 1)
62	        self.act = nn.SiLU()
63	
64	        # Zero-init last conv for stable residual learning
65	        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.weight)
66	        nn.init.zeros_(self.conv2.bias)
67	
68	    @staticmethod
69	    def _group_norm_f32(norm: nn.GroupNorm, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
70	        """GroupNorm in float32: bf16 variance computation overflows."""
71	        return F.group_norm(
72	            x.float(), norm.num_groups, norm.weight.float(), norm.bias.float(), norm.eps
73	        ).to(x.dtype)
74	
75	    @staticmethod
76	    def _conv_f32(conv: nn.Conv2d, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
77	        """Conv2d in float32: F.conv2d requires matching input/weight dtypes."""
78	        return F.conv2d(
79	            x.float(), conv.weight.float(),
80	            conv.bias.float() if conv.bias is not None else None,
81	            stride=conv.stride, padding=conv.padding,
82	        ).to(x.dtype)
83	
84	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
85	        residual = x
86	        x = self._conv_f32(self.conv1, self.act(self._group_norm_f32(self.norm1, x)))
87	        x = self._conv_f32(self.conv2, self.act(self._group_norm_f32(self.norm2, x)))
88	        return residual + x
89	
90	
91	class TemporalSelfAttention(nn.Module):
92	    """Pre-norm self-attention across temporal dimension + FFN.
93	
94	    Input / Output shape: (B, T, C) where B = H'×W' spatial positions.
95	    """
96	
97	    def __init__(self, dim: int, num_heads: int = 8, max_len: int = 128):
98	        super().__init__()
99	        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
100	        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
101	        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
102	        self.ff = nn.Sequential(
103	            nn.Linear(dim, dim * 4),
104	            nn.GELU(),
105	            nn.Linear(dim * 4, dim),
106	        )
107	
108	        # Fixed sinusoidal positional embedding for temporal positions
109	        self.register_buffer("pos_embed", self._sinusoidal(max_len, dim))
110	
111	    @staticmethod
112	    def _sinusoidal(max_len: int, dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
113	        pe = torch.zeros(max_len, dim)
114	        pos = torch.arange(max_len).unsqueeze(1).float()
115	        div = torch.exp(torch.arange(0, dim, 2).float() * (-math.log(10000.0) / dim))
116	        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(pos * div)
117	        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(pos * div)
118	        return pe
119	
120	    def _layer_norm_f32(self, norm: nn.LayerNorm, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
121	        """LayerNorm in float32."""
122	        return F.layer_norm(
123	            x.float(), norm.normalized_shape, norm.weight.float(), norm.bias.float(), norm.eps
124	        ).to(x.dtype)
125	
126	    def _attn_f32(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
127	        """Multi-head attention in float32: bf16 softmax(QK^T) overflows."""
128	        B, T, D = x.shape
129	        x_f32 = x.float()
130	        qkv = F.linear(x_f32, self.attn.in_proj_weight.float(), self.attn.in_proj_bias.float())
131	        q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
132	        head_dim = D // self.attn.num_heads
133	        q = q.view(B, T, self.attn.num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
134	        k = k.view(B, T, self.attn.num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
135	        v = v.view(B, T, self.attn.num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
136	        out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
137	        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, T, D)
138	        out = F.linear(out, self.attn.out_proj.weight.float(), self.attn.out_proj.bias.float())
139	        return out.to(x.dtype)
140	
141	    def _ff_f32(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
142	        """FFN in float32: F.linear requires matching input/weight dtypes."""
143	        h = x.float()
144	        h = F.linear(h, self.ff[0].weight.float(), self.ff[0].bias.float())
145	        h = F.gelu(h)
146	        h = F.linear(h, self.ff[2].weight.float(), self.ff[2].bias.float())
147	        return h.to(x.dtype)
148	
149	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
150	        T = x.shape[1]
151	        x = x + self.pos_embed[:T].to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
152	
153	        h = self._layer_norm_f32(self.norm1, x)
154	        h = self._attn_f32(h)
155	        x = x + h
156	
157	        h = self._layer_norm_f32(self.norm2, x)
158	        h = self._ff_f32(h)
159	        x = x + h
160	        return x
161	
162	
163	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
164	# FlowEncoder
165	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
166	
167	class FlowEncoderPreTrainedModel(PreTrainedModel):
168	    """Trainable optical flow encoder: flow → ResNet + Temporal Attention → features.
169

171	    encodes into 512-dim features with temporal self-attention.

175	    - Explicit temporal modeling via self-attention

3	import torch
4	import torch.nn as nn
5	import torch.nn.functional as F
6	from transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2 import Qwen2RMSNorm
7	
8	
9	class MotionMLPAddConnector(nn.Module):
10	    def __init__(
11	        self,
12	        motion_dim,
13	        language_dim,
14	        visual_temporal_merge_size,
15	        visual_spatial_merge_size,
16	    ) -> None:
17	        super().__init__()
18	        self.motion_dim = motion_dim
19	        self.language_dim = language_dim
20	        self.visual_temporal_merge_size = visual_temporal_merge_size
21	        self.visual_spatial_merge_size = visual_spatial_merge_size
22	
23	        self.merged_dim = motion_dim * visual_temporal_merge_size * visual_spatial_merge_size ** 2
24	        print(f"MotionMLPAddConnector: motion_dim={motion_dim}, merged_dim={self.merged_dim}, language_dim={language_dim}")
25	
26	        # MLP: merged_dim → merged_dim → language_dim (same as Spatial-MLLM)
27	        self.ln_motion = Qwen2RMSNorm(self.merged_dim, eps=1e-6)
28	        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
29	            nn.Linear(self.merged_dim, 2048),
30	            nn.GELU(),
31	            nn.Linear(2048, language_dim),
32	        )
33	
34	        # Cross-attention: visual (Q) attends to motion (K/V), then residual
35	        self.ln_q = nn.LayerNorm(language_dim)
36	        self.ln_kv = nn.LayerNorm(language_dim)
37	        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(language_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True)
38	
39	    def preprocess_motion_features(
40	        self,
41	        motion_features_list: List[torch.Tensor],
42	        grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
43	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
44	        """
45	        Align motion features to match the visual token grid, then merge temporal+spatial patches.
46	
47	        Args:
48	            motion_features_list: List of [T_i, motion_dim, Hf_i, Wf_i] tensors from motion encoder.
49	            grid_thw: Tensor of shape [num_grid_rows, 3] with (t, h, w) for each video segment.
50	
51	        Returns:
52	            Tensor of shape [total_tokens, merged_dim].
53	        """
54	        temporal_merge = self.visual_temporal_merge_size
55	        spatial_merge = self.visual_spatial_merge_size
56	        all_motion_embeds = []
57	        grid_idx = 0
58	
59	        for feat in motion_features_list:
60	            # feat: [T, motion_dim, Hf, Wf]
61	            T, C, Hf, Wf = feat.shape
62	
63	            # Consume grid_thw rows for this video.
64	            # Each video corresponds to one grid_thw row in Qwen2.5-VL.
65	            if grid_idx >= len(grid_thw):
66	                raise ValueError(f"Not enough grid_thw rows for motion features")
67	
68	            t_val, h_val, w_val = grid_thw[grid_idx].tolist()
69	            npatch_t = int(t_val)
70	            npatch_h = int(h_val)
71	            npatch_w = int(w_val)
72	            grid_idx += 1
73	
74	            target_T = npatch_t * temporal_merge
75	
76	            # Pad or truncate temporal dimension to match target_T
77	            if T < target_T:
78	                pad = feat[:1].expand(target_T - T, -1, -1, -1)
79	                feat = torch.cat([feat, pad], dim=0)
80	            elif T > target_T:
81	                indices = torch.linspace(0, T - 1, target_T, dtype=torch.long, device=feat.device)
82	                feat = feat[indices]
83	
84	            # Adaptive pool to align spatial dims with visual grid
85	            feat = F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(feat, (npatch_h, npatch_w))
86	            # feat: [target_T, motion_dim, npatch_h, npatch_w]
87	
88	            # Reshape for temporal merge:
89	            # [npatch_t, temporal_merge, motion_dim, npatch_h, npatch_w]
90	            feat = feat.view(npatch_t, temporal_merge, C, npatch_h, npatch_w)
91	
92	            # Reshape for spatial merge:
93	            # [npatch_t, temporal_merge, motion_dim, npatch_h/sm, sm, npatch_w/sm, sm]
94	            feat = feat.view(
95	                npatch_t,
96	                temporal_merge,
97	                C,
98	                npatch_h // spatial_merge,
99	                spatial_merge,
100	                npatch_w // spatial_merge,
101	                spatial_merge,
102	            )
103	            # Permute to group merge dims:
104	            # [npatch_t, npatch_h/sm, npatch_w/sm, spatial_merge, spatial_merge, motion_dim, temporal_merge]
105	            feat = feat.permute(0, 3, 5, 4, 6, 2, 1).contiguous()
106	
107	            # Flatten to [N_tokens, merged_dim]
108	            n_tokens = npatch_t * (npatch_h // spatial_merge) * (npatch_w // spatial_merge)
109	            feat = feat.reshape(n_tokens, C * temporal_merge * spatial_merge ** 2)
110	
111	            all_motion_embeds.append(feat)
112	
113	        return torch.cat(all_motion_embeds, dim=0)
114	
115	    def _cross_attn_f32(self, query: torch.Tensor, key: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
116	        """Cross-attention in float32 to prevent bf16 gradient overflow."""
117	        ca = self.cross_attn
118	        D = ca.embed_dim
119	        num_heads = ca.num_heads
120	        head_dim = D // num_heads
121	        B, N_q, _ = query.shape
122	        _, N_kv, _ = key.shape
123	
124	        q = F.linear(query.float(), ca.in_proj_weight[:D].float(), ca.in_proj_bias[:D].float())
125	        k = F.linear(key.float(), ca.in_proj_weight[D:2*D].float(), ca.in_proj_bias[D:2*D].float())
126	        v = F.linear(value.float(), ca.in_proj_weight[2*D:].float(), ca.in_proj_bias[2*D:].float())
127	
128	        q = q.view(B, N_q, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
129	        k = k.view(B, N_kv, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
130	        v = v.view(B, N_kv, num_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
131	
132	        out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v)
133	        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, N_q, D)
134	        out = F.linear(out, ca.out_proj.weight.float(), ca.out_proj.bias.float())
135	        return out
136	
137	    def forward(
138	        self,
139	        video_embeds: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
140	        image_embeds: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
141	        motion_features_list: List[torch.Tensor] = None,
142	        grid_thw: torch.Tensor = None,
143	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
144	        assert video_embeds is not None or image_embeds is not None, \
145	            "Either video_embeds or image_embeds must be provided."
146	
147	        visual_embeds = video_embeds if video_embeds is not None else image_embeds  # [N, language_dim]
148	        orig_dtype = visual_embeds.dtype
149	
150	        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=False):
151	            # Preprocess (tensor ops: view/permute/pool — dtype-agnostic)
152	            motion_embeds = self.preprocess_motion_features(motion_features_list, grid_thw)
153	
154	            # RMSNorm (already does fp32 internally; fp32 input keeps output fp32)
155	            motion_embeds = self.ln_motion(motion_embeds.float())
156	
157	            # MLP in fp32
158	            h = F.linear(motion_embeds, self.mlp[0].weight.float(), self.mlp[0].bias.float())
159	            h = F.gelu(h)
160	            motion_embeds = F.linear(h, self.mlp[2].weight.float(), self.mlp[2].bias.float())
161	
162	            visual_embeds_f32 = visual_embeds.float()
163	
164	            # LayerNorms in fp32
165	            visual = F.layer_norm(
166	                visual_embeds_f32, self.ln_q.normalized_shape,
167	                self.ln_q.weight.float(), self.ln_q.bias.float(), self.ln_q.eps,
168	            ).unsqueeze(0)  # [1, N, language_dim]
169	            motion = F.layer_norm(
170	                motion_embeds, self.ln_kv.normalized_shape,
171	                self.ln_kv.weight.float(), self.ln_kv.bias.float(), self.ln_kv.eps,
172	            ).unsqueeze(0)  # [1, N, language_dim]
173	
174	            # Cross-attention in fp32
175	            attn_out = self._cross_attn_f32(visual, motion, motion)
176	
177	            result = visual_embeds_f32 + attn_out.squeeze(0)  # residual
178	
179	        return result.to(orig_dtype)
180	
181	    def print_trainable_parameters(self) -> None:
182	        is_trainable = any(param.requires_grad for param in self.parameters())
183	        print(f"MotionMLPAddConnector Trainable: {is_trainable}")

1	from typing import List, Optional
2	
3	import torch
4	import torch.nn as nn
5	import torch.nn.functional as F
6	
7	
8	class FlowGuidedTemporalConnector(nn.Module):
9	    """Flow-guided token warping followed by temporal fusion.
10	
11	    For each video token time step k, forward flow is used to sample the
12	    corresponding token locations from step k + 1. The current token, warped
13	    next token, their difference, and the flow token are concatenated and
14	    projected back to the language hidden size:
15	
16	        update_k = MLP([Z_k, Warp(Z_{k+1}, F_k), Warp(Z_{k+1}, F_k) - Z_k, M_k])
17	        output_k = Z_k + eta * update_k
18	
19	    No token-wise gate is used so the temporal branch is forced to participate.
20	    """
21	
22	    def __init__(self, lang_dim: int, hidden_dim: int = 2048, eta: float = 2e-1, **kwargs):
23	        super().__init__()
24	        self.lang_dim = lang_dim
25	        self.temporal_mlp = nn.Sequential(
26	            nn.LayerNorm(4 * lang_dim),
27	            nn.Linear(4 * lang_dim, hidden_dim),
28	            nn.GELU(),
29	            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, lang_dim),
30	        )
31	        self.register_buffer("eta", torch.tensor(float(eta)), persistent=False)
32	
33	    def _split_sizes(self, grid_thw: torch.Tensor, total_tokens: int):
34	        if grid_thw is None:
35	            return [total_tokens]
36	        split_sizes = [int(t) * int(h) * int(w) for t, h, w in grid_thw.tolist()]
37	        if sum(split_sizes) != total_tokens:
38	            raise ValueError(
39	                f"grid_thw token count mismatch: expected {sum(split_sizes)}, got {total_tokens}"
40	            )
41	        return split_sizes
42	
43	    @staticmethod
44	    def _resize_temporal(flow: torch.Tensor, target_t: int) -> torch.Tensor:
45	        """Align flow length to Qwen's pre-merge video frame count."""
46	        if flow.shape[0] == target_t:
47	            return flow
48	        if flow.shape[0] < target_t:
49	            pad = flow[-1:].expand(target_t - flow.shape[0], -1, -1, -1)
50	            return torch.cat([flow, pad], dim=0)
51	        indices = torch.linspace(0, flow.shape[0] - 1, target_t, dtype=torch.long, device=flow.device)
52	        return flow[indices]
53	
54	    @staticmethod
55	    def _flow_to_token_displacement(flow: torch.Tensor, gt: int, gh: int, gw: int) -> torch.Tensor:
56	        """Convert MOFNet forward flow to token-grid displacement.
57	
58	        MOFNet flow is predicted on its own low-resolution feature grid. We
59	        spatially resize it to the merged token grid and scale vector values
60	        into token units. Qwen video tokens cover two frames, so two adjacent
61	        frame-level flows are summed into one token-time displacement.
62	        """
63	        # Use forward flow only: [T, 2, Hf, Wf]
64	        flow = flow[:, :2].float()
65	        target_t = gt * 2
66	        flow = FlowGuidedTemporalConnector._resize_temporal(flow, target_t)
67	        flow_h, flow_w = flow.shape[-2:]
68	
69	        flow = F.interpolate(flow, size=(gh, gw), mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
70	        flow[:, 0] = flow[:, 0] * (float(gw) / float(flow_w))
71	        flow[:, 1] = flow[:, 1] * (float(gh) / float(flow_h))
72	
73	        # [gt, 2 frames, 2, gh, gw] -> [gt, 2, gh, gw]
74	        flow = flow.view(gt, 2, 2, gh, gw).sum(dim=1)
75	        return torch.nan_to_num(flow, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
76	
77	    @staticmethod
78	    def _warp_next(next_tokens: torch.Tensor, displacement: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
79	        """Sample next token map at flow-predicted source locations."""
80	        # next_tokens: [H, W, D], displacement: [2, H, W] in token units.
81	        h, w, d = next_tokens.shape
82	        if h <= 1 or w <= 1:
83	            return next_tokens
84	
85	        dtype = next_tokens.dtype
86	        device = next_tokens.device
87	        yy, xx = torch.meshgrid(
88	            torch.arange(h, device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
89	            torch.arange(w, device=device, dtype=torch.float32),
90	            indexing="ij",
91	        )
92	        src_x = xx + displacement[0].to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
93	        src_y = yy + displacement[1].to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
94	        grid_x = 2.0 * src_x / max(w - 1, 1) - 1.0
95	        grid_y = 2.0 * src_y / max(h - 1, 1) - 1.0
96	        grid = torch.stack([grid_x, grid_y], dim=-1).unsqueeze(0)
97	
98	        source = next_tokens.permute(2, 0, 1).unsqueeze(0).float()
99	        warped = F.grid_sample(source, grid, mode="bilinear", padding_mode="border", align_corners=True)
100	        return warped.squeeze(0).permute(1, 2, 0).to(dtype)
101	
102	    def _mlp_f32(self, concat_tokens: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
103	        hidden = F.layer_norm(
104	            concat_tokens.float(),
105	            self.temporal_mlp[0].normalized_shape,
106	            self.temporal_mlp[0].weight.float(),
107	            self.temporal_mlp[0].bias.float(),
108	            self.temporal_mlp[0].eps,
109	        )
110	        hidden = F.linear(
111	            hidden,
112	            self.temporal_mlp[1].weight.float(),
113	            self.temporal_mlp[1].bias.float(),
114	        )
115	        hidden = F.gelu(hidden)
116	        hidden = F.linear(
117	            hidden,
118	            self.temporal_mlp[3].weight.float(),
119	            self.temporal_mlp[3].bias.float(),
120	        )
121	        return hidden
122	
123	    def forward(
124	        self,
125	        visual_embeds: torch.Tensor,
126	        flow_embeds: torch.Tensor,
127	        grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
128	        flow_list: Optional[List[torch.Tensor]] = None,
129	        **kwargs,
130	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
131	        if flow_list is None:
132	            raise ValueError("FlowGuidedTemporalConnector requires raw flow_list for token warping.")
133	
134	        orig_dtype = visual_embeds.dtype
135	        split_sizes = self._split_sizes(grid_thw, visual_embeds.shape[0])
136	        visual_chunks = torch.split(visual_embeds, split_sizes, dim=0)
137	        flow_embed_chunks = torch.split(flow_embeds, split_sizes, dim=0)
138	
139	        fused_chunks = []
140	        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=False):
141	            for visual_chunk, flow_embed_chunk, raw_flow, thw in zip(
142	                visual_chunks, flow_embed_chunks, flow_list, grid_thw.tolist()
143	            ):
144	                gt, gh, gw = [int(v) for v in thw]
145	                z = visual_chunk.float().view(gt, gh, gw, self.lang_dim)
146	                m = flow_embed_chunk.float().view(gt, gh, gw, self.lang_dim)
147	
148	                if gt <= 1:
149	                    fused_chunks.append(z.reshape(-1, self.lang_dim))
150	                    continue
151	
152	                displacement = self._flow_to_token_displacement(raw_flow, gt, gh, gw)
153	                displacement = displacement.to(device=z.device)
154	
155	                out = z.clone()
156	                updates = []
157	                for k in range(gt - 1):
158	                    warped_next = self._warp_next(z[k + 1], displacement[k])
159	                    concat = torch.cat([z[k], warped_next, warped_next - z[k], m[k]], dim=-1)
160	                    updates.append(self._mlp_f32(concat))
161	
162	                update_stack = torch.stack(updates, dim=0)
163	                out[:-1] = z[:-1] + self.eta.float() * update_stack
164	                fused_chunks.append(out.reshape(-1, self.lang_dim))
165	
166	        return torch.cat(fused_chunks, dim=0).to(orig_dtype)
167	
168	    def print_trainable_parameters(self) -> None:
169	        trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
170	        total = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
171	        is_trainable = any(p.requires_grad for p in self.parameters())
172	        print(f"FlowGuidedTemporalConnector Trainable: {is_trainable} ({trainable:,}/{total:,} params)")
173

1	"""
2	Motion-adapter decoder layer for Qwen2.5-VL.
3	
4	The previous full duplicated FFN was numerically unstable in SFT. This layer
5	keeps the original FFN unchanged and adds a small video-token-only residual
6	adapter inside selected LLM blocks:
7	
8	    hidden_states = residual + mlp_out + video_mask * MotionAdapter(motion_guide)
9	
10	There is no learnable gate/alpha. The adapter up projection is zero-initialized,
11	so training starts exactly from the original Qwen block and learns a motion
12	residual only where video tokens are present.
13	"""
14	
15	import torch
16	import torch.nn as nn
17	import torch.nn.functional as F
18	from transformers.models.qwen2.modeling_qwen2 import Qwen2MLP, Qwen2RMSNorm
19	from transformers.models.qwen2_5_vl.modeling_qwen2_5_vl import (
20	    Qwen2_5_VLAttention,
21	    GradientCheckpointingLayer,
22	)
23	
24	# Module-level storage shared between MotionMLLM and decoder layers.
25	# Each DDP process has its own model copy, so no cross-process contention.
26	_dual_ffn_video_token_mask = None
27	_dual_ffn_motion_guide = None
28	
29	
30	class Qwen2_5_VLDualFFNDecoderLayer(GradientCheckpointingLayer):
31	    """Qwen2.5-VL decoder layer with a video-token motion adapter."""
32	
33	    def __init__(self, config, layer_idx: int, adapter_dim: int = 256):
34	        super().__init__()
35	        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
36	        self.adapter_dim = int(adapter_dim)
37	
38	        self.self_attn = Qwen2_5_VLAttention(config, layer_idx)
39	
40	        self.mlp = Qwen2MLP(config)
41	        self.motion_adapter_down = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, self.adapter_dim, bias=False)
42	        self.motion_adapter_up = nn.Linear(self.adapter_dim, config.hidden_size, bias=False)
43	        self.motion_adapter_act = nn.GELU()
44	
45	        self.input_layernorm = Qwen2RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
46	        self.post_attention_layernorm = Qwen2RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
47	
48	        from transformers.models.qwen2_5_vl.modeling_qwen2_5_vl import logger
49	        if config.use_sliding_window and config._attn_implementation != "flash_attention_2":
50	            logger.warning_once(
51	                f"Sliding Window Attention is enabled but not implemented for `{config._attn_implementation}`; "
52	                "unexpected results may be encountered."
53	            )
54	        self.attention_type = config.layer_types[layer_idx]
55	
56	    def init_motion_adapter(self):
57	        nn.init.trunc_normal_(self.motion_adapter_down.weight, std=0.02)
58	        nn.init.zeros_(self.motion_adapter_up.weight)
59	
60	    def _motion_adapter_f32(self, motion_states):
61	        """Run the motion guide adapter in fp32 to avoid bf16 overflow."""
62	        autocast_ctx = (
63	            torch.amp.autocast(device_type="cuda", enabled=False)
64	            if motion_states.is_cuda
65	            else torch.amp.autocast(device_type="cpu", enabled=False)
66	        )
67	        with autocast_ctx:
68	            x = motion_states.float()
69	            x = F.layer_norm(x, (self.hidden_size,))
70	            x = F.linear(x, self.motion_adapter_down.weight.float())
71	            x = self.motion_adapter_act(x)
72	            x = F.linear(x, self.motion_adapter_up.weight.float())
73	        return x
74	
75	    def forward(
76	        self,
77	        hidden_states,
78	        attention_mask=None,
79	        position_ids=None,
80	        past_key_values=None,
81	        output_attentions=False,
82	        use_cache=False,
83	        cache_position=None,
84	        position_embeddings=None,
85	        **kwargs,
86	    ):
87	        residual = hidden_states
88	        hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
89	
90	        hidden_states, self_attn_weights = self.self_attn(
91	            hidden_states=hidden_states,
92	            attention_mask=attention_mask,
93	            position_ids=position_ids,
94	            past_key_values=past_key_values,
95	            output_attentions=output_attentions,
96	            use_cache=use_cache,
97	            cache_position=cache_position,
98	            position_embeddings=position_embeddings,
99	            **kwargs,
100	        )
101	        residual = residual.to(device=hidden_states.device, dtype=hidden_states.dtype)
102	        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states
103	
104	        residual = hidden_states
105	        hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)
106	        h_visual = self.mlp(hidden_states)
107	
108	        mask = _dual_ffn_video_token_mask
109	        motion_guide = _dual_ffn_motion_guide
110	        if mask is not None and motion_guide is not None:
111	            _, S, _ = hidden_states.shape
112	            if mask.shape[1] == S and motion_guide.shape[:2] == hidden_states.shape[:2]:
113	                motion_guide = motion_guide.to(device=hidden_states.device, dtype=hidden_states.dtype)
114	                h_motion = self._motion_adapter_f32(motion_guide)
115	                h_motion = torch.nan_to_num(h_motion, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
116	                mask_3d = mask.unsqueeze(-1).to(device=h_motion.device, dtype=h_motion.dtype)
117	                h_motion = h_motion * mask_3d
118	            else:
119	                h_motion = torch.zeros_like(h_visual)
120	        else:
121	            h_motion = torch.zeros_like(h_visual)
122	
123	        residual = residual.to(device=h_visual.device, dtype=h_visual.dtype)
124	        h_motion = h_motion.to(device=h_visual.device, dtype=h_visual.dtype)
125	        hidden_states = residual + h_visual + h_motion.to(h_visual.dtype)
126	
127	        outputs = (hidden_states,)
128	        if output_attentions:
129	            outputs += (self_attn_weights,)
130	        return outputs
131

63	            torch.amp.autocast(device_type="cuda", enabled=False)
64	            if motion_states.is_cuda

66	        )

75	    def forward(

78	        attention_mask=None,
79	        position_ids=None,

82	        use_cache=False,
83	        cache_position=None,

88	        hidden_states = self.input_layernorm(hidden_states)
89

91	            hidden_states=hidden_states,
92	            attention_mask=attention_mask,
93	            position_ids=position_ids,
94	            past_key_values=past_key_values,
95	            output_attentions=output_attentions,
96	            use_cache=use_cache,
97	            cache_position=cache_position,

100	        )
101	        residual = residual.to(device=hidden_states.device, dtype=hidden_states.dtype)
102	        hidden_states = residual + hidden_states
103	
104	        residual = hidden_states
105	        hidden_states = self.post_attention_layernorm(hidden_states)
106	        h_visual = self.mlp(hidden_states)
107	
108	        mask = _dual_ffn_video_token_mask
109	        motion_guide = _dual_ffn_motion_guide

111	            _, S, _ = hidden_states.shape
112	            if mask.shape[1] == S and motion_guide.shape[:2] == hidden_states.shape[:2]:
113	                motion_guide = motion_guide.to(device=hidden_states.device, dtype=hidden_states.dtype)

1	import torch
2	import torch.nn as nn
3	import torch.nn.functional as F
4	
5	
6	class FlowGuidedAdapterConnector(nn.Module):
7	    """Use flow tokens as motion guidance to modulate RGB visual tokens.
8	
9	    This connector treats flow features as conditioning signals instead of an
10	    extra visual modality to be directly added. Flow tokens generate FiLM-style
11	    scale and shift parameters for the RGB tokens:
12	
13	        output = visual + alpha * (gamma(flow) * LN(visual) + beta(flow))
14	
15	    The small alpha initialization keeps the model close to the RGB-only
16	    baseline at startup while still allowing gradients to reach the modulator.
17	    """
18	
19	    def __init__(self, lang_dim: int, hidden_dim: int = 2048, init_alpha: float = 1e-1, **kwargs):
20	        super().__init__()
21	        self.lang_dim = lang_dim
22	        self.ln_visual = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
23	        self.ln_flow = nn.LayerNorm(lang_dim)
24	        self.flow_mlp = nn.Sequential(
25	            nn.Linear(lang_dim, hidden_dim),
26	            nn.GELU(),
27	            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 2 * lang_dim),
28	        )
29	        self.alpha = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(float(init_alpha)))
30	
31	    def _modulator_f32(self, flow_embeds: torch.Tensor):
32	        flow_hidden = F.layer_norm(
33	            flow_embeds.float(),
34	            self.ln_flow.normalized_shape,
35	            self.ln_flow.weight.float(),
36	            self.ln_flow.bias.float(),
37	            self.ln_flow.eps,
38	        )
39	        flow_hidden = F.linear(
40	            flow_hidden,
41	            self.flow_mlp[0].weight.float(),
42	            self.flow_mlp[0].bias.float(),
43	        )
44	        flow_hidden = F.gelu(flow_hidden)
45	        flow_hidden = F.linear(
46	            flow_hidden,
47	            self.flow_mlp[2].weight.float(),
48	            self.flow_mlp[2].bias.float(),
49	        )
50	        gamma, beta = flow_hidden.chunk(2, dim=-1)
51	        return gamma, beta
52	
53	    def forward(
54	        self,
55	        visual_embeds: torch.Tensor,
56	        flow_embeds: torch.Tensor,
57	        grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
58	        **kwargs,
59	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
60	        orig_dtype = visual_embeds.dtype
61	        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=False):
62	            visual_f32 = visual_embeds.float()
63	            visual_norm = F.layer_norm(
64	                visual_f32,
65	                self.ln_visual.normalized_shape,
66	                self.ln_visual.weight.float(),
67	                self.ln_visual.bias.float(),
68	                self.ln_visual.eps,
69	            )
70	            gamma, beta = self._modulator_f32(flow_embeds)
71	            delta = gamma * visual_norm + beta
72	            fused = visual_f32 + self.alpha.float() * delta
73	        return fused.to(orig_dtype)
74	
75	    def print_trainable_parameters(self) -> None:
76	        trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
77	        total = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
78	        is_trainable = any(p.requires_grad for p in self.parameters())
79	        print(f"FlowGuidedAdapterConnector Trainable: {is_trainable} ({trainable:,}/{total:,} params)")
